description: I'm Computer Science student and tech enthusiast.
summary:
Our project, ASTRIS Clinical Console, is a crew health case management system designed for deep space missions. It helps monitor astronaut health and manage medical incidents by organizing each crew member's health information, physiological readings, active concerns, and recovery history in one place.

When an unsafe health condition is detected, the system records it as an OPEN incident. When the crew or medical staff acknowledge it and begin taking action, its status changes to ACKNOWLEDGED. Once recovery is confirmed, the incident is marked as RECOVERED. This allows the crew and medical teams to follow the complete history of a health problem rather than just viewing alerts.

We developed the system using React, TypeScript, and Express.js, and integrated NASA's NeoWs API to provide near-Earth object information and space-environment context. The biometric readings used in the demonstration are synthetic, while the NASA object data is real public data.

The main benefit is better organisation, incident tracking, and visibility into astronaut recovery. What makes our project creative is its focus on the complete clinical workflow, from detecting a problem to confirming recovery, rather than simply displaying health measurements.

Our goal is to improve astronaut health management, support medical coordination, and contribute to safer long duration space missions.
